category_title: Difficult students who alternate between ostentatious task engagement and masked transgressive play
scenario_title: Tumbling workshop with rapid behavioral switching and peer disruption
minimal_context: The student is practicing somersaults in a small group tumbling workshop along the gym wall.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start the tumbling workshop and practice your somersaults.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Performs the required somersault, then stays lying down on his back for 10 seconds) I did the somersault.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Trips up Maureen and laughs) I'm practicing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quickly shoves Ines just when she does the exercise so she falls, then pushes Alice who was about to do a roll) Me and my friends have a good laugh. I do it quickly and discreetly so I don't get caught by the teacher.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start the tumbling workshop and practice your somersaults.

STUDENT: (Performs the required somersault, then stays lying down on his back for 10 seconds) I did the somersault.

TUTOR: Get up and keep practicing.

STUDENT: (Trips up Maureen and laughs) I'm practicing.

TUTOR: Pay attention to the exercise.

STUDENT: (Quickly shoves Ines just when she does the exercise so she falls, then pushes Alice who was about to do a roll) Me and my friends have a good laugh. I do it quickly and discreetly so I don't get caught by the teacher.

context.environment: Gymnastics classes, organized into small workshops... systematically organized the workshops along the wall of the gym
context.social_setting: Working in a group with peers (Maureen, Alice, Ines)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Alice was about to do a roll
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: changed his behaviour eight times. He performed the required somersault, stayed 10 seconds lying down on his back, tripped up Maureen, laughed, pushed Alice who was about to do a roll, messed up with Alice by lightly slapping her, took a long run before jumping, then did the required somersault without getting up afterwards.

behavior_patterns.condition: just when she does the exercise
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: quickly shove Ines just when she does the exercise so she falls
behavior_patterns.internal_state: me and my friends have a good laugh
related_quotes: In fact, I shove Ines just when she does the exercise so she falls and ...me and my friends have a good laugh.
Yes, I do it quickly and discreetly so I don’t get caught by the teacher. ( ...) After that we go back to work and the teacher won’t say anything to us.
